name: Naive Jumping Farthest Away (JFA)
definition: A GPU-based algorithm for computing the Signed Distance Field (SDF) and position of the closest surface point for a voxel grid. It uses a multi-pass approach where the search radius K is halved in each iteration to propagate distance information from known surface points to empty space.
summary: Naive JFA is a GPU algorithm that computes signed distance fields by propagating data via a multi-pass approach with a logarithmically halving search radius.
